correctness.rationale: For every of 2^12-1=4095 nonempty vertex masks, the adjacency-derived induced maximum degree test correctly decides membership. The complex has exactly 455 nonempty faces, with f-vector (12,66,164,177,36). The committed certificate provides 211 disjoint covering-relation pairs; all 1512 nonempty face-poset coverings are oriented and a full Kahn traversal eliminates all 455 nodes, proving acyclicity, leaving one critical 0-cell and exactly 32 critical 3-cells. Forman discrete Morse therefore gives a CW complex with precisely one point and 32 attached 3-cells, so integral homotopy type is a wedge of 32 three-spheres. Independent forbidden-triple enumeration and mod-two ranks (11,55,109,36) corroborate counts, not substitute for homotopy proof.

value.rationale: The cuboctahedral graph L(Q3) is canonical, four-regular, edge-transitive, contains both triangles and squares, and lies outside the extensively classified path/cycle/forest/complete multipartite higher-independence families. Its complex is a natural P3-free nonflag invariant on selected edges of the cube. The exact 32-fold integral three-sphere wedge, despite dimension four, is a complete motivated finite benchmark in polyhedral line-graph topology, and not a routine restatement of homology or an arbitrary parameter slice. No broad classification is falsely claimed.
